calls.title: Skyscanner + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting detailed GrowthBook's offerings, distinguishing between open source and enterprise versions. Enterprise provides scalability with features like fine-grain permissions, audit logs, and up to 10x more efficient database queries, whereas open source is suited for smaller teams and lacks advanced integrations. Customization options for enterprise users were highlighted, showcasing its modular capabilities that allow flexible adoption. The team also explored Skyscanner's hybrid model strategy to balance build versus buy, emphasizing metrics management and experimental flexibility. A Proof of Concept (POC) to validate GrowthBook's suitability for CX experiments was planned for Q1, with a focus on integrating historic experiments from Skyscanner's warehouse and enhancing data analytics beyond mere experimentation.
